pose.description: Primary whole-body pose; variations belong in notes.

view.description: Dominant torso orientation relative to camera.

notes.description: Only garment-relevant pose, body/environment contact, or occlusion information not captured by crop/pose/view. Do not repeat styling or describe original clothing. Use compact phrases; empty string when unnecessary.

styling.description: Only stable, compatible styling relationships from Image 1 that materially affect the whole outfit, such as layering, tuck, overlap, sleeve treatment, or accessory placement. No generic styling commentary, garment identity, color, print, logo, exact construction, hidden details, background, or lighting. Use compact phrases; empty string when unnecessary.

garments.description: Target outfit items shown in Images 2 onward, including garments, footwear, bags, belts, hats, and accessories.

main_refs.description: Minimum sufficient images defining overall silhouette, proportions, structure, or major construction. Prefer one clear overall reference; add another only for necessary structural information not established by the primary reference. Do not list every image showing the item.

shape.description: Compact phrases describing the defining intrinsic silhouette, proportions, volume, and major construction. Exclude pose folds, temporary deformation, Image 1 styling, and details better represented in key_details.

fabric_behavior.description: Compact phrases describing visually supported material behavior: crispness, softness, structure, fluidity, volume retention, drape, cling, and folds. Do not guess composition or stretch, or repeat shape.

presentation.description: Only non-obvious, item-specific wearing adjustments required by the fixed pose or compatible styling that materially affect reconstruction. Do not repeat shape, subject.styling, visible pose, or generic natural-wearing instructions. Empty string when no special handling is needed.

key_details.description: A few distinctive, high-impact, source-grounded features that define the item or are easy to miss from the main reference, ordered by importance. Select per item, not per image. Omit ordinary visible construction, redundant, tiny, ambiguous, or hidden details. Empty array when no explicit attention is needed.

region.description: Semantic location such as overall, collar, cuff, waistband, pocket, hem, footwear, bag_front, or buckle. Use overall only for all-over patterns, stripes, color blocking, broad panel arrangement, or distinctive whole-item layout.

description.description: Compact, factual, source-grounded phrase beyond shape and other details; direct attention without explaining reasoning.

source_ref.description: Exactly one clearest authoritative image for this detail; split facts into separate details when they require different sources.
